Free browser survival & building

Worldloom

A world to make your own.

Start with a seed and see where it takes you. Gather wood, shape a shelter, follow a cave underground, or stop beside a pond. Worldloom is a voxel survival and building game you can play straight from your browser, alone or with one friend.

PLAY WORLDLOOM →

No game download. Desktop keyboard and mouse recommended. The game needs JavaScript and browser graphics support.

Getting startedControlsSaving & friendsQuestions

Find your footing

Gather. Build. Go further.

Forests, water, caves and changing daylight give you places to explore and reasons to prepare. Mine blocks for materials, open your pack to browse recipes, and place what you make back into the world. Workbenches and furnaces unlock recipes that need a nearby station.

Wayfarer

The survival journey. Gather supplies, watch your food and health, and make a plan before going underground. Eating and resting are part of staying ready for the next trip.

Dreamweaver

The building journey. Choose this mode for a freer approach to shaping the landscape and use flight to see your builds from above.

  1. Name your world. Enter an optional seed to choose its starting terrain, or leave the seed blank for a surprise. Pick your journey and create the world.
  2. Let the starting area load. When you arrive, click inside the game to look around. Use your pack's recipe book to decide which materials to gather first.
  3. Take supplies before exploring. Bring food in Wayfarer, use your headlamp in caves, and keep an eye out for the Bell Shrine and Quarry Rig. Their chests open to show loot you can choose to take.

At your fingertips

Worldloom controls

The main keyboard and mouse controls. Click inside the world to capture the mouse; Escape releases it and opens pause.
W A S DMove
MouseLook around
Space / ShiftJump or swim / sprint
Left mouse buttonMine blocks or attack
Right mouse buttonPlace a block or use the held item; open a chest when aimed at it
EOpen or close your pack and recipe book
RInteract with the object in front of you
1–9Select a quickbar slot
FToggle the headlamp
GToggle flight in Dreamweaver
J / EscShow your objective / pause

In a chest, click a stack to take that item or choose Take all. Loot that does not fit stays in the chest. In your pack, select a stack and then a destination slot to move it.

Keep your place

Save your world. Bring a friend.

Playing as a guest

You can start a guest world without an account. Its save is kept in this browser. Use Continue to return to the last saved world, and use the game's save-and-return option when leaving. Clearing browser data or switching browsers can make that local save unavailable.

Account worlds

Sign in through Account for saved worlds tied to your account. You can own up to 10 worlds, open them from the Worlds tab, and delete worlds you no longer want. Set your username in Account; it is the name other players see.

Two players, one shared world

Generate your four-digit friend code in Account and ask your friend for theirs. During world creation, choose Invite player and enter that code. Your friend can accept through Received invites. Each world supports you and one invited friend, and either person can play while the other is offline. Shared worlds need an internet connection.

Before you jump in

Worldloom questions

Is Worldloom free to play?
Yes. You can open and play Worldloom in your browser without buying the game or downloading an installer.
Where can I find loot?
Look for a Wayfarer Bell Shrine or an Abandoned Quarry Rig on land. Aim at its chest and press R or right-click to see the contents. Take individual stacks or use Take all; anything that does not fit remains in the chest.
Can I play with more than one friend?
Worldloom currently supports two players per account world: the owner and one invited friend.
Do I need an account?
No for a local guest world. Yes for account saves, friend codes and shared worlds. You can sign in with Google or verify your email, then choose a password.
What should I change if the game runs slowly?
Open Settings and lower graphics quality, view distance or render scale. Worldloom renders a 3D world, so browser graphics acceleration and the device's graphics hardware affect performance.
Can I use the same seed again?
Yes. Enter the same seed when making another world to start from its generated terrain. A seed does not copy your buildings, inventory or saved progress.
